priors_and_data: Same frozen numerical HKL values, cell, elements, Laue and centring for both solvers. Exact group/counts/coordinates withheld. Same seed, worker, numerical and resource controls. Exposed development/regression set, not a holdout.
acceptance: All previous checks and thresholds remain. Every equivalent group candidate remains ambiguous and unaccepted.

automatic_deferral.alternatives: Every BIC-close alternative, at least one different group number. All must have same parameter count and element-labelled full-cell model.

fitting: Exact reuse: initial evaluation, fixed-site sin/cos, identical-bit reciprocal weights, unchanged orbit counts. Original value/Jacobian reduction order preserved.
grading: Previous labelled counts, common origin/inversion, RMS <=0.025 A and maximum <=0.05 A. Strict maximum <=0.02 A and unlabelled positions secondary. Models saved before reference grading. No reference used for selection.
kernel_benchmark: Same 10-atom/4168-point benchmark compiled against frozen baseline and changed source; 20 samples, 1 s warmup, 2 s measurement, serial runs without competing build/test/profiling work.
